preconditions.expression: all(any(a == u and b == v for u, v in edges) for a, b in nodes) or all(any(a == u and b == v for u, v in edges) for b, a in nodes)
1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b
preconditions.description: The destinations a and b are valid node indices.
The energy requirement e is within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(E_max(c_i) == max_energy(c_i) for i, c_i in enumerate(corridors))
postconditions.description: The output contains the largest energy requirement e for each corridor c_i such that changing the energy requirement to e would make the Daleks use c_i in their invasion.
